opportunities.name: Dash-weave chase
opportunities.objective: Turn Spirit Rush into spaced attack windows.
opportunities.mechanic: Fox-Fire grants 40% decaying speed and Spirit Rush permits three initial dashes over 15 seconds. Nashor's Tooth rewards actual attacks; Dusk and Dawn adds one Spellblade attack and repeats on-hits. AP still powers Charm and both Orb passes, so the attack experiment retains spell damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Need Charm connected, an isolated target and time between dashes for attacks.
opportunities.failure: Lost burst can prevent the first takedown and its healing/recast reward.
opportunities.test: Compare attacks landed and total damage over one moving-target R chase at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Three dash casts do not guarantee three independently ready Spellblade procs.

opportunities.name: Return-orb finisher
opportunities.objective: Exploit the return pass against armored targets.
opportunities.mechanic: Orb of Deception has 0.5 AP on each pass, with true damage returning. Shadowflame explicitly enhances magic and true damage below 40% health; Cosmic Drive triggers on either type, letting W speed and R relocation steer the return. Void Staff supports the other magic hits rather than penetrating true damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Keep the target intersecting both Orb paths and push below Shadowflame's threshold before return.
opportunities.failure: Dashes away from the return path or shields can erase the proposed finish.
opportunities.test: Measure outbound and return separately above and below 40%, then repeat versus different MR.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration does not increase Q's true damage half.

ruledOut.reason: Charm and Fox-Fire have AP magic ratios, not ordinary attack crit scaling.

unknowns: Dusk and Dawn repeat-on-hit behavior needs a live attack log; Spirit Rush acquisition can split bolts between targets.

opportunities.name: Trample spellblade brawler
opportunities.objective: Make the delayed Trample stun a damage delivery window.
opportunities.mechanic: Trample deals 0.7 AP magic damage over five seconds and requires five champion-damaging pulses before the stunning attack. Dusk and Dawn gives that actual attack a magic Spellblade payload; Riftmaker rewards staying in combat and R's seven-second reduction helps survive the wait. Rylai's slow may keep enemies near E.
opportunities.requiredState: Need close contact for five E stacks, R available and an attack after the charge.
opportunities.failure: Headbutting the target away or being kited interrupts E stacking; low spell ranks limit damage.
opportunities.test: Record time to stun and damage over an E cycle against a moving target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The E stun's bonus damage has a level expression, not an AP ratio.

opportunities.name: Roar health battery
opportunities.objective: Convert accumulated health into repeated team healing.
opportunities.mechanic: Triumphant Roar restores 5% max health to Alistar and 1.4 times that to nearby allies at seven stacks. Heartsteel health increases the documented base heal, while Moonstone chains allied healing and Redemption supports the clustered formation. Q/W disruptions and nearby deaths provide real stacks, rather than attack speed directly accelerating Roar.
opportunities.requiredState: Need nearby allies, actual CC/death stacks and bounded Heartsteel procs accumulated before the fight.
opportunities.failure: Healing triggers can arrive too late and health without resistances becomes vulnerable outside R.
opportunities.test: Compare allied health restored per Roar and survival during then after R, with fixed Heartsteel stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Moonstone's allied chain excludes self and does not multiply R damage reduction.

ruledOut.reason: E's damage is AP magic; attack AD only helps ordinary attacks, not every pulse.

unknowns: Verify whether the extracted Roar healing is affected by heal power and Moonstone without double-counting self healing.

opportunities.name: Storm shred corridor
opportunities.objective: Use terrain to hold targets through stacking magic effects.
opportunities.mechanic: Glacial Storm triples its damage after 1.5 seconds and then chills for doubled Frostbite, whose base 0.55 AP becomes 1.1 AP on chilled targets. Bloodletter's Curse rewards repeated ability magic hits; Blackfire Torch and Malignance add area pressure. Crystallize makes remaining in that fully formed storm more realistic.
opportunities.requiredState: Need mana, a held corridor and R uninterrupted long enough to form.
opportunities.failure: Leaving the storm, interrupting the toggle or mana exhaustion leaves an expensive low-mobility build exposed.
opportunities.test: Track shred stacks, time inside R and doubled E damage over four seconds.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R damage is not immediately tripled at the first tick.

opportunities.name: Egg siege survivor
opportunities.objective: Buy time for the six-second Rebirth transformation.
opportunities.mechanic: Rebirth returns Anivia to a full-health egg with level-dependent defenses and requires six seconds of survival. Rod of Ages health and Seraph's shield support the initial life; Zhonya's can delay burst before lethal damage, while Q stun and W terrain limit access. AP retains the doubled E threat that discourages enemy commitment.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Tear, aged Rod, Rebirth ready and teammates able to defend the egg.
opportunities.failure: A stationary egg remains easy to focus; delaying death may allow opponents to surround it.
opportunities.test: Compare time survived before egg and egg survival against one versus three attackers.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not assume active items can be cast while egg-bound or the Seraph shield resets on Rebirth.

ruledOut.reason: Rebirth is a survival state, not a turret or independently attacking pet.

unknowns: Egg item-state inheritance and automatic shield timing require live checks; raw armor interpolation flags remain ambiguous.

opportunities.name: Arrow-first hybrid barrage
opportunities.objective: Follow an AP arrow catch with three rapid attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Enchanted Crystal Arrow carries a 1.2 AP magic ratio and up to 3.5 seconds of stun. Fiendhunter Bolts grants three accelerated crit attacks after R, Nashor supports these actual attacks, and Malignance rewards R's magic hit. This tests pick burst plus follow-up, while Q still needs four attack stacks before activation.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a clear arrow lane and ability to reach attack range during the stun.
opportunities.failure: A global arrow may land beyond follow-up range; low AD weakens extended Q trades.
opportunities.test: Measure arrow alone, three attacks and then Q availability at several arrow distances.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Ashe crits enhance Frost Shot behavior; do not assume normal bonus crit damage on her attacks.

opportunities.name: Volley pursuit bruiser
opportunities.objective: Use repeated physical Volley to expose and soften fleeing teams.
opportunities.mechanic: Volley has an AD statFormula=2 expression and only its first arrow damages a given target. Muramana offers mana and physical spell payload subject to proc rules; Cleaver shreds armor through physical damage, Shojin supports repeated abilities, and Youmuu supplies physical penetration and an active movement burst for positioning. Hawkshot helps choose safe approach lines between casts.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Manamune, real W hits and allies able to exploit softened targets.
opportunities.failure: Low attack DPS and single-hit Volley cannot rapidly shred one target; R remains weak without AP.
opportunities.test: Record W intervals and armor stacks over repeated volleys, versus a normal attack build.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Multiple arrows striking one champion do not grant multiple damage events or full Cleaver stacks.

ruledOut.reason: Current Imperial Mandate marks on immobilization; Volley's slow alone does not qualify.

unknowns: Ashe passive crit formula remains symbolic; Muramana per-cast restrictions and Fiendhunter special crit handling require live validation.

opportunities.name: Soldier resistance shred
opportunities.objective: Trade instant burst for a sustained soldier control zone.
opportunities.mechanic: Arise soldiers deal magic damage with a rank-scaling 0.35-0.65 AP ratio; attack speed enables more commanded stabs. Bloodletter's stacks from qualifying magic abilities, Riftmaker rewards sustained combat and Nashor provides AP/attack speed even if soldier on-hit efficacy is unresolved. E shield and R wall buy continued command time.
opportunities.requiredState: Need mana, soldiers covering the target and repeated commands before soldiers expire.
opportunities.failure: Soldier displacement or forced E escape can remove the damage zone; extra on-hit expectations may fail.
opportunities.test: Compare stab count and MR stacks over eight seconds, with Nashor on-hit contribution logged separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Sand Soldiers are not automatically full-strength ordinary attacks for every item proc.

opportunities.name: Sun Disc ambush anchor
opportunities.objective: Use a reclaimed turret as a temporary high-AP fight anchor.
opportunities.mechanic: Shurima's Legacy Sun Disc lasts 45 seconds, deals magic damage with 0.4 AP and has level-scaled defenses. High AP powers its documented damage plus Emperor's Divide's 0.75 AP displacement. Rocketbelt helps angle E/R near the occupied rubble; Zhonya's buys time while opponents choose whether to retreat past soldiers or contest the Disc.
opportunities.requiredState: Need eligible turret rubble, Disc ready and a fight within its limited lifetime.
opportunities.failure: Enemies can disengage or destroy the Disc; investing in burst lowers steady soldier pressure.
opportunities.test: Compare turret damage and E/R catch success with and without a prepared Disc, at equal AP.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The Disc's existence does not establish inheritance of Nashor or owner item on-hits.

ruledOut.reason: W's documented soldier damage is AP magic, without a crit coefficient.

unknowns: Soldier on-hit reduction, Disc item-proc ownership and attack-command exceptions need live checks.

opportunities.name: Power Fist AD uppercut
opportunities.objective: Make the doubled-AD empowered attack the primary burst.
opportunities.mechanic: Power Fist explicitly deals 2 AD plus 0.25 AP physical damage and knocks up for one second. Essence Reaver supplies a separate physical Spellblade payload; Sundered Sky can reward the first champion attack with healing. Bloodmail turns purchased health into AD, W supplies five seconds of attack speed, and Cleaver supports physical follow-up.
opportunities.requiredState: Need Q connection or melee access, E ready and W exit planned before its self-slow.
opportunities.failure: Q/R magic damage loses AP scaling, and the carry can disengage after the knockup.
opportunities.test: Log base E, Spellblade and Sundered Sky components independently before comparing a three-attack trade.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not multiply all item bonus damage by E's 2 AD coefficient or assume E crit stacking.

opportunities.name: Mana-shield lightning boxer
opportunities.objective: Turn a mana reserve into a durable repeated-attack threat.
opportunities.mechanic: Mana Barrier gives a shield equal to 35% of the ability resource expression, while available R marks attacked targets for delayed magic shocks with an AP ratio and 0.02 resource expression. Seraph and Frozen Heart add mana, Nashor and Dusk and Dawn reward actual W-assisted attacks, and Visage enhances received shields. Holding R preserves lightning availability.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Tear, enough current resource, R unspent and time for one-second shocks.
opportunities.failure: Casting R removes the available-ultimate premise; spending mana before the shield can reduce protection.
opportunities.test: Compare shield and delayed shock damage at full versus spent mana while keeping R active unused.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Do not read ability resource default as unquestionably maximum mana or free permanent damage.

ruledOut.reason: Rocket Grab and Static Field deal magic damage; lethality only serves attacks and physical E.

unknowns: Current-versus-maximum mana interpretation, R re-mark timing and E/Sundered Sky crit treatment need live logs.

opportunities.name: Wall scream mage
opportunities.objective: Use Head Rush to line up an AP wall collision.
opportunities.mechanic: Chilling Scream has 1 AP magic damage on release and 2.4 AP magic wall-hit damage when fully charged; Certain Death landing adds 1.3 AP magic. Rocketbelt helps create the wall angle, Gunblade offers mixed stats and a slowing active, and magic penetration serves E/R. Q's AP term deals physical damage, so it is secondary here.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a nearby wall, uninterrupted full E charge and a planned frenzy cancellation.
opportunities.failure: Charging gives targets time to sidestep; weak physical sustained damage makes a failed wall hit costly.
opportunities.test: Measure release versus wall bonus separately, then compare realistic Q-to-wall sequences against a dodging target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP does not strengthen W's main AD attack loop or make Q magic damage.

opportunities.name: Bleed health conversion
opportunities.objective: Convert actual healing windows and health into physical pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: Crimson Curse stacks physical bleed to five and heals from pre-mitigation bleed; W recast restores health from its damage and a max-health term. Bloodmail converts bonus health to AD, Visage enhances self healing, and Cleaver targets the physical loop. E's max-health heal and reduction can stabilize a dangerous low-health recast before Death's Dance requires a real takedown.
opportunities.requiredState: Need controlled W access, an E escape and a living target for bleed ticks.
opportunities.failure: Anti-heal, forced target selection and instant burst can prevent the expected sustain.
opportunities.test: Compare healing and survival over one W/E cycle, with and without healing reduction and fixed health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Bleed stacks are capped; self-taunt is a positioning liability, not free permanent uptime.

ruledOut.reason: Crimson Curse's bleed uses an AD statFormula expression rather than an AP ratio.

unknowns: AD statFormula=2 and health stat IDs are preserved symbolically; wall damage additive handling needs testing.

opportunities.name: Poison stride engine
opportunities.objective: Use amplified move bonuses to maintain poisoned Twin Fang range.
opportunities.mechanic: Primary Serpentine Grace amplifies movement bonuses and Q grants 30-50% decaying speed on a champion hit. Cosmic Drive triggers on magic damage; repeated poisoned Twin Fang gains an additional 0.45 AP damage and AP healing. Bloodletter rewards the sustained magic sequence, while Rod/Seraph address mana. Boots eligibility is confirmed by Riot’s 26.1 passive rework; movement benefits remain outside the damage model.
opportunities.requiredState: Need maintained poison, sufficient mana and room to move; boots eligibility follows the 26.1 rework.
opportunities.failure: A missed Q removes both speed and enhanced E, and silence or mana pressure breaks the chase.
opportunities.test: Measure E hits, healing and distance maintained during a moving poison duel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Rylai or item burns are not poison merely because they deal damage over time.

opportunities.name: Miasma sustain bunker
opportunities.objective: Hold a grounded zone long enough for healing to matter.
opportunities.mechanic: Miasma persists five seconds, poisons and grounds enemies, permitting enhanced E without another Q hit. Liandry and Riftmaker reward continued magic combat; Visage increases received healing and health contributes to Riftmaker AP. Petrifying Gaze can extend the zone against facing targets, but turned enemies only receive the slow. Boots eligibility is confirmed by Riot’s 26.1 passive rework.
opportunities.requiredState: Need targets inside W, charged Tear and sufficient mana for repeated E casts.
opportunities.failure: Walking out, long-range poke and anti-heal can defeat the bunker before sustained effects mature.
opportunities.test: Compare ten-second mana use, healing and burn damage versus a mobile opponent.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The separate Triumphant passive record cannot be assumed to grant free level AP or forbid boots live.

ruledOut.idea: Unconditional six-slot AP with no boots
ruledOut.reason: Riot’s 26.1 passive rework permits boots. A six-damage-item setup is a movement tradeoff, not a purchase restriction.

unknowns: The separate Triumphant helper is not the live passive. Riot’s 26.1 notes establish boots eligibility; movement performance still requires gameplay testing.

opportunities.name: Noxian health-to-AD ceiling
opportunities.objective: Convert bounded health growth into amplified execute pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: Hemorrhage reaches five stacks before granting Noxian Might's temporary AD; Guillotine has an AD statFormula expression and doubles damage at five bleeds. Heartsteel and Bloodmail provide a health-to-AD route, Visage supports Q's missing-health edge heal, and Stridebreaker helps remain at axe-edge distance rather than replacing required stack setup.
opportunities.requiredState: Need actual Heartsteel procs, five bleed stacks and a landed outer Q.
opportunities.failure: Low early attack speed and kiting prevent Might; burst can kill before Q healing.
opportunities.test: Compare full-stack R damage and time to Might at fixed Heartsteel stacks, then versus disengage.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: True damage execute gains nothing from armor penetration and its reset needs an actual kill.

opportunities.name: Crippling attack reset duel
opportunities.objective: Use the 90% slow to compress a three-attack trade.
opportunities.mechanic: Crippling Strike's empowered attack reaches 1.6 AD and slows 90% for one second. Trinity supplies one physical Spellblade, Blade of the Ruined King rewards real attacks and Sundered Sky provides first-hit sustain. E pull makes the short window possible, while Cleaver complements the physical bleed/attack portion rather than R's true damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Need attack-W-attack spacing and the pulled target within melee reach.
opportunities.failure: Extra offense sacrifices durability; Q's handle hit adds no bleed and can ruin the follow-up.
opportunities.test: Measure attacks and bleed stacks before slow expiry, with E pull versus an open chase.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: On-hit item damage is separate from W's AD multiplier and is not guaranteed to crit with Sundered Sky.

ruledOut.reason: Q and bleed are physical AD, while R is AD-linked true damage; no useful AP kit ratio appears.

unknowns: Raw AD statFormula flags and empowered-attack crit interactions require live damage breakdowns.

opportunities.name: Axe-catch spellblade rhythm
opportunities.objective: Make each catch a controlled ability-and-attack sequence.
opportunities.mechanic: Spinning Axe adds up to 1.15 AD statFormula=2 physical damage to its attack; catching refreshes Blood Rush. Essence Reaver adds physical Spellblade and mana to a post-W attack, while Stormrazor's energized speed helps reach the next landing circle. Crit supports ordinary attack damage but axe bonus treatment must be measured separately.
opportunities.requiredState: Need two maintained axes, sensible W pacing and room to catch safely.
opportunities.failure: Rapid W refreshes can outpace Spellblade readiness and catching into CC loses both axes.
opportunities.test: Compare mana and total trade damage with W only when Spellblade is ready versus spammed catches.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Catch refresh does not refresh Essence Reaver's internal item cooldown.

opportunities.name: Whirling execution specialist
opportunities.objective: Prioritize two-pass ultimate damage and earned Adoration thresholds.
opportunities.mechanic: Whirling Death has a rank-varying 1.1-1.5 AD expression, reverses after champion contact or recast and loses damage through earlier units. Muramana supplies AD/mana subject to spell proc limits; Axiom refunds R only after qualifying deaths, and lethality serves physical damage. Passive Adoration provides a bounded execute threshold, not combat stats or guaranteed income.
opportunities.requiredState: Need charged Manamune, earned surviving Adoration and an unobstructed return line.
opportunities.failure: Dying halves stacks; unit attenuation or target movement can erase the execute setup.
opportunities.test: Measure both R passes at fixed stack counts and compare early reversal versus maximum travel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Adoration stacks are not unlimited and catching axes does not directly lower R cooldown.

ruledOut.reason: Q's added physical term does not explicitly inherit the attack's crit multiplier.

unknowns: Verify crit treatment of Q bonus and Muramana eligibility on the outbound/return passes.

opportunities.name: Shade-reset whiplash skirmisher
opportunities.objective: Re-enter Shade to refresh empowered Whiplash instead of committing once.
opportunities.mechanic: Demon Shade activates after four seconds without attacks/casts and empowered E refreshes through entering Shade. Whiplash has AP-based percent-max-health magic damage and a dash; Dusk and Dawn rewards an actual attack after the reset and Gunblade slows for the follow-up. Riftmaker is experimental because disengaging can sacrifice its combat ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a safe disengage, level-six camouflage and another empowered E target.
opportunities.failure: Reveal effects, damage or forced combat prevent Shade; sustained items lose immediate assassination power.
opportunities.test: Time a retreat and second empowered E, logging Shade timing and healing threshold with fixed AP.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E's refreshed state is not an unrestricted reset while Evelynn keeps attacking.

opportunities.name: Execute threshold AP dive
opportunities.objective: Push targets across the two separate finishing thresholds.
opportunities.mechanic: Allure after 2.5 seconds removes 35-45% MR, and Q's marked-target bonuses plus E percent health can prepare Last Caress. R's 0.75 AP damage multiplies by 2.4 below 30% health; Shadowflame boosts magic damage below 40%. Rocketbelt improves access, and Banshee helps protect the initial approach.
opportunities.requiredState: Need full charm preparation and health below 30% before R damage resolves.
opportunities.failure: Telegraphing W permits escape; shields or mistimed R produce the weaker damage case.
opportunities.test: Measure R at 29%, 31% and 41% target health with the same MR and AP.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Shadowflame's 40% threshold does not by itself activate R's separate 30% multiplier.

ruledOut.reason: E and R are magic damage even when delivered in melee range.

unknowns: Whiplash item on-hit applicability is not proved by the tooltip; routes depend on logged ordinary attacks instead.

opportunities.name: Vital orbit attack engine
opportunities.objective: Use attack windows to reach all four real Vitals.
opportunities.mechanic: Duelist's Dance deals percent-max-health true damage with an AD statFormula expression and rewards directional hits. Lunge's hit halves its cooldown; Trinity and Blade reward attack weaving, while Ravenous sustain helps tolerate orbiting. Hullbreaker's fifth attack adds separate physical pressure, and E's two fast attacks create brief movement-safe damage windows.
opportunities.requiredState: Need open space around the target, Q hits and all four sides accessible before eight seconds.
opportunities.failure: Walls can block Vitals; attack items encourage standing still instead of completing R.
opportunities.test: Record Vital completions and ordinary attack damage separately in a wall-side versus open duel.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Item proc damage is not automatically percent-health true damage or a new independent Vital hit.

opportunities.name: Grand Challenge team-heal bruiser
opportunities.objective: Keep enough health and AD to complete a healing field under pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: Grand Challenge's completed field heals nearby allies for 80-130 plus 0.7 AD statFormula=2 per second over five seconds. Bloodmail converts bonus health into AD supporting Vitals and that field; Sundered Sky and Visage stabilize Fiora during setup. Riposte's 0.75-second parry offers a specific survival window before the first Vital.
opportunities.requiredState: Need at least one Vital then a kill, or all four within R's eight seconds.
opportunities.failure: Anti-heal and blocked access undermine both self sustain and team payoff.
opportunities.test: Compare field healing and completion rate versus a higher-damage build while surrounded by two opponents.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Visage improves heals received by Fiora, not the full allied healing field for everyone.

ruledOut.reason: Riposte has 1 AP magic damage, but AP does not scale passive Vitals or the R heal expression.

unknowns: AD statFormula flags, item eligibility on Lunge and fixed second-E crit handling need live measurement.

opportunities.name: Global barrage mage
opportunities.objective: Make global area denial the main AP payoff.
opportunities.mechanic: Cannon Barrage fires 12 magic waves with 0.1 AP each over eight seconds, with earned Fire at Will adding six waves. Malignance and Liandry reward continued ultimate contact; Deathcap increases wave damage and Remove Scurvy's 0.9 AP heal. Barrel slow can help local enemies remain inside R, but barrel damage itself remains attack-derived physical.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a real choke, earned upgrades and R available for the objective fight.
opportunities.failure: Targets leave the area or local physical damage becomes too weak to defend.
opportunities.test: Compare damage for two-, four- and eight-second R exposure, keeping upgrades identical.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The maximum twelve-wave total assumes continuous contact; global range does not guarantee it.

opportunities.name: Trial-by-Fire endurance
opportunities.objective: Use barrel destruction for repeated melee true-damage burns.
opportunities.mechanic: Trial by Fire's burn has an AD statFormula expression, and destroying a Powder Keg refreshes the passive and grants speed. Trinity supports a post-ability attack while Bloodmail links health to AD; Visage helps Scurvy's 13% missing-health component and Sundered Sky rewards contact. This route tests repeated melee resets rather than one crit-barrel detonation.
opportunities.requiredState: Need safe barrel ownership and time to land melee burns between explosions.
opportunities.failure: Opponents defuse barrels or punish melee entry; weaker ranged bursts let them disengage.
opportunities.test: Count passive burns, barrel resets and healing over a controlled eight-second melee skirmish.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Destroying connected barrels cannot be assumed to deal multiple explosion hits to one target.

ruledOut.reason: Kegs inherit the triggering attack's damage; their tooltip does not add a standalone AP ratio.

unknowns: Parrrley wrapper is unresolved; Spellblade propagation and passive refresh ordering require live testing before precise totals.

opportunities.name: Drunken spellblade tank
opportunities.objective: Trade one-shot burst for repeated protected empowered attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: Drunken Rage reduces damage with an AP term and empowers one attack with 0.7 AP plus 7% enemy max-health magic damage. Dusk and Dawn adds a separate attack proc, Riftmaker rewards continued combat, and Visage supports Happy Hour's 5.5% max-health heal. Body Slam's collision reduces its cooldown by 40%, helping create another W window.
opportunities.requiredState: Need E collisions, W timing before contact and Happy Hour availability.
opportunities.failure: Missing E loses the cooldown reduction; W's short protection can expire while chasing.
opportunities.test: Compare W-hit damage, passive healing and E availability across two exchanges at equal gold.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: W's percent-health magic bonus does not multiply separate on-hit item damage.

opportunities.name: Fermented barrel displacement
opportunities.objective: Use a held barrel and R placement to create a larger delayed hit.
opportunities.mechanic: Barrel Roll's 0.8 AP magic damage rises up to 1.5 times as it ages over four seconds. Explosive Cask's 0.8 AP knockback can displace a target toward the prepared barrel; Rocketbelt adjusts the casting angle, while Horizon reveals qualifying long-range ability hits. This is a placement-dependent damage hypothesis rather than an automatic combo.
opportunities.requiredState: Need an aged barrel, a displacement angle and safe range for setup.
opportunities.failure: A wrong R angle ejects the enemy away; detonating Q early sacrifices its multiplier.
opportunities.test: Measure aged-Q damage and successful R-into-Q catches against a moving target, logging range for Horizon.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Every Q detonation is not the full aged damage, and Horizon does not amplify all spells in this source.

ruledOut.reason: Body Slam is AP magic and its collision cooldown reward does not scale from attack speed.

unknowns: Happy Hour internal cooldown is absent from symbolic tooltip; verify separately instead of assuming every cast heals.

opportunities.name: Warpath speed conversion
opportunities.objective: Turn a timed movement burst into physical charge and cleave damage.
opportunities.mechanic: Warpath converts a level-dependent portion of bonus speed to AD; Devastating Charge increases speed from 25% to 65% and its physical damage depends on distance traveled. Youmuu and Dead Man's Plate create a timed entry, Trinity rewards the charge attack, and Shojin supports stacked Rampage afterward. W healing rewards damage actually dealt nearby.
opportunities.requiredState: Need a long entry path, movement effects active and a target reachable before E ends.
opportunities.failure: CC or cramped paths cut distance; speed items without health make the first impact fragile.
opportunities.test: Compare E and three-stack Q damage with speed effects active versus expired, recording actual bonus AD.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Movement-speed soft caps and decay prevent treating listed percentages as unlimited additive AD.

opportunities.name: Spectral AP drain dive
opportunities.objective: Test magic R/W damage while preserving the drain window.
opportunities.mechanic: Onslaught of Shadows has 1 AP magic damage and distance-scaled fear; Spirit of Dread has 0.8 AP over four seconds and heals from Hecarim and nearby allied damage. Liandry and Abyssal support magic pressure, Visage supports received healing, and Rocketbelt helps keep W in contact after the entry. Rampage retains only its native AD loop.
opportunities.requiredState: Need grouped nearby targets and allies damaging enemies inside W's four-second window.
opportunities.failure: Low Q damage and short W duration can lose an extended duel; enemies scatter after fear.
opportunities.test: Compare R/W damage and healing separately from Q over one dive with and without allied follow-up.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: AP does not directly strengthen Rampage; W does not heal from allies damaging remote enemies.

ruledOut.reason: Q has an AD statFormula expression, not an AP ratio; AP builds need W/R contact to pay off.

unknowns: Warpath's speed-stat expression and W damage-source healing eligibility need live checks; preserve raw formula flags.

opportunities.name: Spirit transfer health bruiser
opportunities.objective: Turn health investment into real spirit-transfer pressure.
opportunities.mechanic: Test of Spirit echoes a fraction of spirit damage with a 0.0008 AD expression; Harsh Lesson has AD-linked percent-health physical damage and directs nearby tentacle slams. Bloodmail converts health to AD, Cleaver supports physical hits, and Visage enhances tentacle missing-health heals. Sundered Sky is reserved for Illaoi's actual attack, with spirit classification deliberately unproved.
opportunities.requiredState: Need E connected, usable terrain tentacles and enemies remaining near the spirit.
opportunities.failure: Kiting or destroying tentacles denies the loop; spirit transfer cannot replace direct target access forever.
opportunities.test: Compare owner health lost with spirit-only damage versus owner-plus-spirit overlap, logging individual hits.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Spirit damage and echoed damage are not automatically two independent item procs against the owner.

opportunities.name: Ultimate lesson clock
opportunities.objective: Test more attack-and-slam cycles inside Leap of Faith.
opportunities.mechanic: Leap of Faith grants an eight-second window where tentacles slam 50% faster and W cooldown changes. Trinity adds one physical Spellblade to a real W attack; Blade rewards direct attacks and Shojin raises ability/passive damage after qualifying hits. opportunities.name: Tailwind attack skater

opportunities.name: Hypercharge proc ambush

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Mantra's heal is not flat max-health healing and a broken tether does not grant the completion heal.

opportunities.name: Inspire AP transfer engine

unknowns: Karma Q conditional wrapper is unresolved; identify current normal-Q expression before quoting a numerical burst total.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A pickup cooldown reduction does not mean unconditional instant E resets at every level.

unknowns: Lotus on-hit modifiers, attack-speed statFormula meaning and Rageblade channel applicability need live proof.

opportunities.name: Lightning Rush crit extension

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Extension is conditional on crit events; E itself does not crit or grant permanent attack speed.

opportunities.name: Storm resistance shred dive

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Six ticks are not guaranteed on every target and repeated marks have their own stun behavior.

unknowns: W's fifth-hit on-hit interaction and crit-extension ordering need live checks; R ramp timing must use observed hits.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Four attacks alone do not necessarily reach full Courage; item hits do not grant extra Courage by assumption.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R's percent-health impact is magic despite AD scaling and is not improved by Cleaver's armor shred.

unknowns: Skaarl health allocation, statFormula flags and remount classification as healing need explicit live checks.

opportunities.name: Buckler return trade

Trinity rewards a preceding cast, Dead Man's discharges on an attack and Sundered Sky tests the first champion attack heal. Visage strengthens recovered shielding/healing; E wall collision can buy pickup time.
opportunities.requiredState: Passive ready, spell cast before buckler and an accessible landing point.
opportunities.failure: The opponent destroys the buckler or terrain access costs more health than the shield grants.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A ranged buckler attack does not make every Poppy spell an on-hit carrier.

opportunities.name: Dash gate magic
opportunities.objective: Concentrate budget on punishing dash attempts through W.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: More AP does not cause W to hit enemies who never dash.

unknowns: W resistance Stat terms and Q slow raw-stat expression require validation; buckler item delivery must be logged.

opportunities.name: Mark reset Spellblade
opportunities.objective: Use separated Q/E marks for timed spell-followed attacks.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Applying two marks before attacking does not bank two Harrier consumptions.

opportunities.objective: Test whether returning from Valor can start Fiendhunter's attack window.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R's automatic recast is not established as a fresh item ultimate trigger.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An unresolved E tooltip cross-reference is not absent data: the calculation exists, but its raw AD flag still needs verification. Titanic cannot be combined with Stridebreaker; choose one Cleave item.

opportunities.objective: Trade a burst window for a safe three-second burrow heal and reentry.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Tunnels do not remove their own reuse cooldowns or allow attacks while burrowed.

opportunities.name: Triple-strike item log

opportunities.requiredState: At least 50 Fury reserved for W, active Titanic ready and target shield state recorded.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Three described strikes do not prove three full copies of every item or rune proc.

opportunities.name: Dominus contact AP
opportunities.objective: Test an AP and resistance budget for extended Dominus contact.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The passive summary's 100% wording does not override the detailed record's 150 Heat threshold.

opportunities.name: Harpoon shred burn

opportunities.test: Measure MR and Q/R damage after zero, one and two E hits, separately recording Bloodletter stacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: MR reduction and percentage penetration cannot be added as a single simple percentage.

ruledOut.reason: Rumble uses Heat and the inspected abilities do not spend mana.

unknowns: Heat summary/detail disagreement, shield duration token and passive repeated-on-hit behavior need live checks.

opportunities.requiredState: No allied stack contribution, unstunned target and four verified stacks before E.
opportunities.failure: Slow stack delivery loses E access or expiring armor leaves the attacker vulnerable.

opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Repeated on-hits are not proven to add extra Permafrost stacks.

Terminus supports mixed attack packets; Q's stealth-exit attack speed gives a finite opening to distribute poison.
opportunities.requiredState: Several targets in controlled alignment, Q exit buff and R active; energized state recorded.
opportunities.failure: Misalignment, dodgeable piercing attacks or short contact leaves expensive spread slots unused.
opportunities.test: Count poison stacks and item packets on each aligned/off-axis target with Runaan and Statikk separately equipped.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Runaan bolts are not proven to become additional full piercing R attacks.

ruledOut.reason: E lists per-stack physical and magic formulas without ordinary attack critical strikes.

unknowns: R/Runaan/Statikk propagation and poison item ownership require per-target packet logs; raw AD flags stay unresolved.

opportunities.name: Blight cooldown circuit
opportunities.objective: Use three-stack detonation to reopen basic spells while preserving attack access.
opportunities.mechanic: W supplies AP/AD magic on-hit, three Blight stacks and maximum-cooldown reductions per detonation stack against champions/epic monsters. Nashor and Dusk test attack-to-detonation cycling; R gradually grants three stacks while Q charge amplifies detonation. AP supports both on-hit and percent-health damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Three actual stacks before detonation, target eligible for cooldown refund and Q charge recorded.
opportunities.failure: Charging while exposed prevents attacks or detonating early forfeits health damage and refund.
opportunities.test: Log stacks, Q charge and basic cooldown remaining after one versus three-stack detonations.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Dusk repeat does not establish two Blight stacks from one attack.

opportunities.name: Root volley magic
opportunities.objective: Use R's root to apply Fiendhunter's finite attacks before a charged W-Q finish.
opportunities.mechanic: R roots and applies Blight over its duration; Fiendhunter grants three enhanced basic attacks after R. Statikk offers AD/AP and attack effects; W's missing-health active rewards delaying Q until health falls. Terminus provides mixed penetration only after confirmed attack ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: R lands, three attacks available inside item window and W active held for charged Q.
opportunities.failure: Overlapping R and attack stacks waste the cap or target dies/escapes before Q charge.
opportunities.test: Compare R-three attacks-WQ versus R-WQ, counting capped stacks and all attack/item packets.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Passive's raw Stat(4) formula cannot be assumed to grant a fixed AP/AD amount.

ruledOut.reason: Passive Blight detonation is max-health damage; W active adds a distinct missing-health Q packet.

unknowns: Passive Stat(4), W phantom-hit stacking and exact charge multiplier ordering need in-game verification.

opportunities.name: Researched true ray
opportunities.objective: Prepare Deconstruction before R and test the true-damage finish threshold.
opportunities.mechanic: Three ability stacks trigger AP-scaled true damage and cause R to deal true damage to a recently deconstructed target. Shadowflame explicitly boosts low-health true damage; Cosmic reacts to true/magic damage and can help positioning before channeling. Mana and AP support the preparatory W/E/Q sequence.
opportunities.requiredState: Passive proc confirmed before R, target within beam and channel protected.
opportunities.failure: Missed setup or interruption converts the expected payoff into a short magic channel.
opportunities.test: Record R damage type after zero versus three setup stacks and above versus below 40% target health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Magic penetration cannot increase the researched beam's true damage.

opportunities.name: Attack refresh stack
opportunities.objective: Preserve partial Deconstruction with an occasional safer attack before the next spell.
opportunities.mechanic: Attacks refresh the passive's seven-second duration without adding stacks. RFC offers a charged attack range window and Lich Bane rewards a preceding cast; Q's slow and split geometry can keep a delayed follow-up spell accessible. The expensive attack slot must repay stacks that otherwise expire.
opportunities.requiredState: One or two partial stacks about to expire, RFC ready and safe attack range.
opportunities.failure: The attack exposes Vel'Koz to engage or an ordinary spell could have refreshed stacks more safely.
opportunities.test: Delay follow-up beyond seven seconds with versus without one attack and inspect refresh, proc and exposure.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: An attack refresh is not a new Deconstruction stack, including repeated on-hits.

ruledOut.reason: Passive explicitly says attacks refresh but do not add new stacks.

unknowns: RFC refresh delivery and researched-state duration must be observed; W charge recharge token remains unresolved.

opportunities.name: Mist AP second hit
opportunities.objective: Test AP supporting mist access, W control and ability-marked follow-up attacks.
opportunities.mechanic: W has 1 AP magic damage, E's movement speed scales with AP and Q's marked second attack includes 0.15 AP physical damage plus a heal. Nashor and Dusk support direct attacks during mist, while AP also enters possession healing. The first possession replaces Viego's current items with the victim's items.
opportunities.requiredState: Ability mark present, mist contact and target attackable; test pre-possession first.
opportunities.failure: Low AD weakens normal Q/R threat and possession interrupts the planned item budget.
opportunities.test: Separate W, first attack, Q follow-up and healing with AP varied; repeat before and during a specified possession.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Viego's six owned items are not continuously retained during possession.

opportunities.name: Heartbreaker crit window
opportunities.objective: Test source-explicit crit-stat scaling on Q and R before cashing an ultimate attack volley.
opportunities.mechanic: Q and R expose distinct crit-stat multiplier expressions; R also adds missing-health physical damage. Fiendhunter grants enhanced basic attacks after ultimate use and E supplies attack speed. Infinity Edge/Collector emphasize the opening, with armor penetration supporting confirmed physical packets.
opportunities.requiredState: R ready, specified crit stats, target health recorded and no possession item replacement during baseline.
opportunities.failure: R targets a different lowest-percent-health champion or the burst fails to secure the next soul.
opportunities.test: Vary crit chance/damage independently and log Q/R packets plus three post-R basic attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: A crit-stat multiplier does not prove Q/R randomly crit or duplicate every attack effect.

ruledOut.reason: Possession replaces the victim's ultimate with a free cast of Viego's own R.

unknowns: Q second-hit item inheritance, R attack delivery and crit-stat semantics require logs; possession tests must name the victim and item state.

opportunities.name: Lightning AP ramp
opportunities.objective: Turn AP into passive attack cadence as well as lightning damage.
opportunities.mechanic: Each passive stack grants attack speed with an AP term, up to five stacks, then attacks add AP-scaled chain lightning. Nashor and Rageblade test the attack phase; E has an AP/health shield for staying close, and Riftmaker rewards extended contact. Terminus supports mixed physical/magic attacks after ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: Five earned passive stacks and attack access; Rageblade/Terminus ramps recorded separately.
opportunities.failure: Stacks expire during kiting or low durability prevents reaching full attack ramp.
opportunities.test: Count passive stacks, attack intervals and lightning packets before and after five stacks, with phantom hits isolated.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Chain lightning does not prove extra targets receive Nashor or every on-hit effect.

opportunities.name: Wounded mark revisit
opportunities.objective: Prioritize reaching a second W on the same marked target.
opportunities.mechanic: W's mark lasts eight seconds; recast gains a damage multiplier involving AD and heals missing health. Shojin basic haste and Trinity spell-followed attacks support repeat contact, Bloodmail supplies health-derived AD and Visage strengthens W healing/E shielding. Q stun buys time for the initial setup.
opportunities.requiredState: Same target remains marked, current health/AD recorded and W returns before mark expiry.
opportunities.failure: Target swapping forfeits the heal or crowd control denies the second cast.
opportunities.test: Log first versus marked W damage/heal at matched missing health and changing AD; measure actual revisit time.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The helper labeled Thundering Smash containing R text is not a second Q or R damage source.

ruledOut.reason: W's missing-health heal is described for using it on an already marked target.

unknowns: Passive chain inheritance, W raw bonus-health/AD terms and the obsolete mislabeled helper need live source reconciliation.

opportunities.name: Recall angle Spellblade
opportunities.objective: Build a feather line through spaced casts and change the recall angle with W speed.
opportunities.mechanic: Casts enable feather-leaving attacks; W gives attack speed and champion-hit movement. Essence Reaver rewards one attack after a cast, Stormrazor assists repositioning and Navori tests basic spell recovery through real attacks. E needs three feathers crossing the target to root and exposes crit-stat scaling.
opportunities.requiredState: Feathers placed on a recorded line, W champion hit and three crossings at recall.
opportunities.failure: Attacks cluster feathers at an ineffective angle or movement puts Xayah outside a safe firing position.
opportunities.test: Record feather locations, E hit count and Spellblade packets with stationary versus speed-assisted recall angles.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Feather piercing attacks do not prove every secondary target gets all on-hit effects.

opportunities.name: Featherstorm opening barrage
opportunities.objective: Test whether post-R enhanced attacks can quickly add feathers for a defensive recall.
opportunities.mechanic: R grants 1.5 seconds untargetability and leaves a feather line; Fiendhunter's ultimate-triggered three attacks can add passive feathers after landing. RFC tests one safer opening attack while W speed supports an E root angle. The crit budget supports E's explicit stat expression.
opportunities.requiredState: R cast before attacks, finite feather lifetime and all attacks inside the item window.
opportunities.failure: R travel time or peel denies the volley, and spending R offensively loses a defensive escape.
opportunities.test: Log item window from R cast through landing, attack count and feathers crossing the same target.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Fiendhunter's enhanced attack damage does not automatically enhance E as an ordinary crit.

ruledOut.reason: R lists AD physical damage without an attack crit term; E alone has explicit crit-stat scaling.

unknowns: Passive feather-count/lifetime tokens, E crit multiplier and W secondary-blade item inheritance need live observation.

opportunities.name: Dash AP Flow
opportunities.objective: Test AP on a finite chain of distinct-target E dashes.
opportunities.mechanic: E deals 0.6 AP magic damage and increases subsequent E damage up to four stacks, subject to per-target cooldowns. Cosmic responds to magic damage, Riftmaker rewards extended combat and Lich Bane requires a real follow-up attack. Movement grants Flow, so faster relocation can alter shield availability.
opportunities.requiredState: Several distinct dash targets, E stack duration maintained and finite Flow recorded.
opportunities.failure: Isolated opponents deny E chains; sacrificing crit reduces Q and ordinary attack threat.
opportunities.test: Measure successive E hits on separate targets at zero through four stacks and shield availability after the path.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The same target cannot be redashed immediately simply because E's cast cooldown is short.

opportunities.name: Last Breath three attacks
opportunities.objective: Use R's post-cast armor interaction for a short critical attack follow-up.
opportunities.mechanic: R requires an airborne champion and grants maximum Flow; afterward critical strikes ignore bonus armor for fifteen seconds. Fiendhunter offers three enhanced basic attacks after R and movement from Stridebreaker helps contact. Yasuo's passive doubles crit chance, so a finite crit budget reaches its cap quickly.
opportunities.requiredState: Valid airborne target, R used and three follow-up attacks within the item window.
opportunities.failure: No knockup denies R or peel stops attacks; low enemy bonus armor reduces the special penetration value.
opportunities.test: Compare three post-R attacks versus pre-R against equal total armor with different bonus-armor shares.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: R's bonus-armor ignore is not a blanket reduction to all armor for every spell.

ruledOut.reason: Yasuo builds Flow through movement and does not spend mana.

unknowns: Q primary description explicitly treats it as a basic attack; exact per-target on-hit delivery and modified crit rules still need logs. Passive crit-to-AD token and Fiendhunter critical interaction require live checks.

opportunities.name: AP critical vow
opportunities.objective: Test AP on attacks that are confirmed critical strikes during Transcendence.
opportunities.mechanic: Passive states that critical strikes gain bonus magic damage with AP; Q adds AP magic on-hit and R instantly activates its enhanced state. Fiendhunter supplies a finite post-R critical volley, while Nashor and Deathcap support AP packets and Infinity Edge tests the separate critical component.
opportunities.requiredState: R ready, item volley active and individual attack crit status logged.
opportunities.failure: AP costs lower physical carry damage and the finite volley ends before a takedown.
opportunities.test: Separate physical crit, passive magic and Q/Nashor packets across AP values, with item-forced versus natural crits.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Passive's compact expression does not establish the base quantity its magic coefficient multiplies.

opportunities.name: Unleash spread audit
opportunities.objective: Compare Q's native spread with item-based on-hit distribution.
opportunities.mechanic: Attacks earn one Unleash or two against champions; eight enables five seconds of Q attack speed, extra on-hit and physical spread. Runaan and Statikk provide separate described on-hit propagation. E speed or its R-state dash supports access, while Terminus requires actual attack ramp.
opportunities.requiredState: Eight earned Unleash without R in baseline, several off-axis enemies and recorded energized state.
opportunities.failure: Spread targets stand out of range or AP/attack budget delays essential single-target damage.
opportunities.test: Count Unleash and per-target Q/Statikk/Runaan packets with Q inactive and active, then R-state separately.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Native Q physical spread does not state that it carries all item or passive on-hits.

ruledOut.reason: Q native spread lists 0.3 AD physical damage; AP improves its distinct magic on-hit rather than that spread term.

unknowns: Passive magic coefficient basis and Q spread inheritance need live testing. R calculations supply empowered W 160/320/480 plus 1.2 AD[statFormula=2] and 0.75 AP despite unresolved tooltip rendering; empty W2/E2 helpers do not establish delivery rules.

opportunities.name: Bounce Goo cooldown
opportunities.objective: Use R's permitted W casts and Goo pickups to generate additional finite W opportunities.
opportunities.mechanic: R bounces four times and explicitly allows W; W deals AP-scaled max-health magic damage and each absorbed Goo reduces its cooldown by one second. Cosmic and R speed assist pickup paths, Visage increases actual Goo healing and Riftmaker rewards sustained combat. E champion hits spawn extra chunks.
opportunities.requiredState: Finite Goo chunks generated by actual hits, pickup path accessible and W cooldown recorded.
opportunities.failure: Enemies deny chunks or the pickup route loses contact with W targets.
opportunities.test: Count chunks spawned/absorbed and W casts during one R with versus without pickups, logging health costs.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Four bounces do not prove four full first-hit R packets against one enemy.

opportunities.name: Stretch attack payoff
opportunities.objective: Test the Q-granted attack as a delivery window before the two-target collision.
opportunities.mechanic: Q grants the next attack range and its AP/bonus-health damage; attacking a different enemy pulls both together for a collision packet. Dusk rewards the prior Q cast and Nashor supports the attack, while Rocketbelt can adjust the geometry and AP improves E's entry damage.
opportunities.requiredState: Q attaches first target, a different target is attackable and Goo costs/pickups recorded.
opportunities.failure: No second target denies collision or the attack range increase still cannot reach it.
opportunities.test: Log Q first hit, enhanced attack, collision and item packets for same-target versus different-target attacks.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: The Q collision is not established as another on-hit attack copying Dusk/Nashor.

ruledOut.reason: Cell Division revival depends on surviving bloblet health and has a five-minute cooldown.

unknowns: Q enhanced-attack item delivery, Goo spawn limits and bloblet inherited item effects require live logs.

opportunities.name: Short Fuse siege cycle
opportunities.objective: Reduce passive cooldown through casts and deliver repeated structure attacks.

Lich Bane tests spell-followed structure attacks; Nashor supports actual attack cadence while Hullbreaker rewards fifth attacks and nearby siege minions. W destroys towers only after the specified health threshold.
opportunities.requiredState: A reachable tower, tracked passive/Spellblade cooldowns, wave present and W threshold recorded.
opportunities.failure: Defenders force retreat before attacks and delaying mana or penetration loses wave control.
opportunities.test: Log tower damage after spaced casts and every fifth attack, separating Short Fuse, Lich Bane and Hullbreaker.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Short Fuse's structure multiplier is not automatically applied to item damage.

opportunities.name: Satchel mine path
opportunities.objective: Force a mine crossing before landing the center of R.
opportunities.mechanic: W knocks enemies away and E mines slow for a finite ten-second area. Directed W can move a target across E and delay escape from R's center, which deals more than its edge. Bloodletter tests magic damage ramp, Cosmic supports repositioning and Liandry asks for retained damage contact.
opportunities.requiredState: Mines placed on the expected knockback path and R center aimed at the resulting position.
opportunities.failure: Incorrect W direction clears the target away from mines or R delay permits escape.
opportunities.test: Count mine damage packets and center/edge R hits with W knockback through versus away from E.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: E primary description states successive mine detonations on one target deal reduced damage, so do not sum full packets.

ruledOut.reason: W's destruction requires the tower to be below its rank-dependent health percentage.

unknowns: Passive base cooldown token, mine repeat-hit attenuation and structure item inheritance need measured checks.

opportunities.name: Enraged plant shred
opportunities.objective: Test plant-driven MR reduction while R extends their attack opportunity.

Bloodletter requires magic damage from abilities or passives, making plant classification a testable question. Liandry/Blackfire test sustained ability burn attribution; Cosmic helps stay safely near the controlled area.
opportunities.requiredState: Recorded seed count and plants alive inside R, target remains in plant range.
opportunities.failure: Plants are killed before attacks or enemies leave, preventing shred and burn ramp.
opportunities.test: Record plant-only packets and Bloodletter stacks before/after R, then add one direct spell to separate ownership.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Pet magic damage is not automatically an ability/passive hit for every item proc.

opportunities.objective: Use E control and slowing plants to support nearby allied attacks.

Bandlepipes activates on slowing or immobilizing champions and grants nearby allies attack speed; Shurelya supports group entry while R's delayed knockup prolongs the zone. Rylai tests whether plant damage renews slow beyond native Lasher control.
opportunities.requiredState: Allies within aura range, E hit or qualifying slow confirmed and finite seeds positioned before R.
opportunities.failure: Allies cannot attack or Thorn Spitters replace needed Lashers; redundancy of slows wastes gold.
opportunities.test: Measure allied attack intervals after direct E versus plant-only slow, and compare one/two Lasher slow states.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Bandlepipes' ally attack-speed aura does not prove it accelerates Zyra's pets.
